submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single full-body native 1024×1024 RGBA game animation frame, hit/W/03, for the original fire talisman boy in the reference images.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative identity portrait: preserve his face, chestnut high ponytail, red gemstone gold crown, red/gold flame-trim short robe, black trousers, red/black/gold shoes, five red talisman cards held as a fan in ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, bronze bell with red tassel held in ANATOMICAL LEFT hand. Image 2 is W-facing idle: preserve its exact left-facing side camera and chibi scale; near hand is LEFT bell hand, far hand is RIGHT talisman hand. Image 3 is the MAIN STYLE REFERENCE: match its bright, clean, rounded, refined hand-painted Daoist chibi forms and warm gold material quality, but do not draw the UI, lettering, landscape, cards or extra characters.
Primary request: redraw the same boy in a physically clear hit-reaction extreme, hit frame 03 out of 06. He faces screen-left. An invisible impact comes FROM screen-left, so his upper torso, head and ponytail recoil BACK toward screen-right; head tipped back with squeezed eye and a brief hurt expression, not smiling. Keep the face recognizable and in side profile. His hips remain centered near x512; weight sinks through visibly bent knees with two separately readable legs and correctly hinged ankles. Near left leg braces slightly toward screen-right with its shoe planted on the virtual floor y920, while the far right foot slides a short distance forward toward screen-left with toe contact. This is a controlled standing recoil, not falling over, not jumping and not attacking. The LEFT near arm bends defensively toward the torso while retaining a clear firm grip on the bell's handle; the bell hangs from that hand with its mouth and red tassel readable. The far RIGHT arm retains the fan of EXACTLY FIVE red talisman cards close to the chest; cards remain physically held together and do not float. Natural shoulders, elbows, wrists and short chibi fingers, no limb merging.
Composition/framing: fixed orthographic side-view game camera and same body proportions as idle; entire figure and every prop fit in the square with ample margins. Character normal standing crown-top benchmark y145, virtual floor y920, root anchor x512/y920; allow the true hit posture to lower head naturally without scaling or changing camera. Keep torso centered and the same overall character scale, not cropped, not zoomed. One frame only, one character only.
Style/medium: high-quality clean hand-painted 2D chibi, round expressive face, large head, short compact body and short limbs; precise warm gold ornament, bright red fabric with restrained highlights, black fabric with clear volume, crisp readable silhouette. Preserve portrait identity in the side pose.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no scenery, no opaque or checkered backdrop.
Constraints: no motion blur, no afterimages, no duplicate limbs, no detached particles, no fire, no magic aura, no energy trails, no floating talismans, no impact star, no baked ground shadow, no cast shadow outside the silhouette, no writing, no watermark, no grid, no labels. Do not mirror the portrait's handedness. Independently paint this new pose rather than stretching or rotating the idle. Output the single image at native 1024×1024 or larger square, with genuine transparency.
